modules.title: Nutrition Fundamentals
modules.description: Learn the basics of healthy eating and balanced nutrition

lessons.title: Understanding Macronutrients
lessons.content: Macronutrients are the nutrients that provide calories or energy. They include carbohydrates, proteins, and fats. Each plays a vital role in maintaining health and supporting bodily functions.

quiz.question: Which macronutrient provides the most energy per gram?

lessons.title: Essential Vitamins and Minerals
lessons.content: Micronutrients are vitamins and minerals that your body needs in small amounts to function properly. They support immune function, bone health, and many other vital processes.

quiz.question: Which vitamin is known as the 'sunshine vitamin'?

modules.title: Exercise and Physical Activity
modules.description: Discover how to incorporate safe, effective exercise into your routine

lessons.title: Cardiovascular Exercise
lessons.content: Cardiovascular exercise, also known as cardio or aerobic exercise, is essential for heart health. It helps strengthen your heart and lungs, improves circulation, and can help manage weight.

quiz.question: What is the recommended minimum amount of cardio exercise per week?

lessons.title: Strength Training Basics
lessons.content: Strength training helps build and maintain muscle mass, which is important for metabolism, bone density, and overall functional strength. It can be done with weights, resistance bands, or bodyweight exercises.

quiz.question: How often should you strength train major muscle groups?

modules.title: Mental Health and Wellbeing
modules.description: Explore strategies for managing stress and promoting mental wellness

lessons.title: Understanding Stress
lessons.content: Stress is a natural response to challenges or demands. While some stress can be motivating, chronic stress can negatively impact both physical and mental health. Learning to manage stress is key to overall wellbeing.

quiz.question: Which of these is a healthy way to manage stress?

lessons.title: Introduction to Mindfulness
lessons.content: Mindfulness is the practice of being present and fully engaged in the current moment. It can help reduce anxiety, improve focus, and enhance emotional regulation.

quiz.question: What is a key component of mindfulness practice?

modules.title: Managing Chronic Conditions
modules.description: Learn strategies for living well with diabetes, hypertension, and other chronic conditions

lessons.title: Understanding Diabetes
lessons.content: Diabetes is a chronic condition that affects how your body processes blood sugar (glucose). There are two main types: Type 1, where the body doesn't produce insulin, and Type 2, where the body doesn't use insulin effectively.

quiz.question: What is the primary hormone that regulates blood sugar?

lessons.title: Understanding Blood Pressure
lessons.content: Blood pressure is the force of blood pushing against the walls of your arteries. High blood pressure (hypertension) can damage your blood vessels and lead to serious health problems like heart disease and stroke.

quiz.question: What is considered a normal blood pressure reading?

modules.title: Building Healthy Habits
modules.description: Discover how to create lasting lifestyle changes for better health

lessons.title: The Importance of Sleep
lessons.content: Quality sleep is essential for physical health, mental clarity, and emotional wellbeing. During sleep, your body repairs tissues, consolidates memories, and regulates hormones.

quiz.question: How many hours of sleep do most adults need per night?

lessons.title: Staying Hydrated
lessons.content: Water is essential for nearly every bodily function, including temperature regulation, nutrient transport, and waste removal. Proper hydration supports energy levels, cognitive function, and physical performance.

quiz.question: What percentage of the human body is made up of water?
